record.name: MrScraper
record.one_liner: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping and data extraction platform providing REST APIs, SDKs, and proxies.

auth.notes: API requests require authentication using an API token passed in the x-api-token header.

access.notes: Users can sign up for a free plan instantly without a credit card and obtain an API token from account settings.

api_surface.notes: Offers a REST API along with Python, Node.js, and LangChain SDKs, plus webhooks for integrations.

mcp.notes: The MrScraper MCP server source code is available on GitHub to let AI agents fetch and extract web data through the Model Context Protocol.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve credentials are available instantly upon signup, and the API is fully documented with cURL and SDK examples.

evidence.claim: Mentions SDKs, Webhooks, and MCP server availability.
Scraper Free plan includes 1,000 tokens per month at no cost and requires no credit card.
